# Balance mod: the game's file, copied whole, with only the colony window's
# building lock added to each type's can_destroy (balance_building_not_kept).
# Generated by write_building_locks.py -- rerun it after every game update.
dock = {
	allow = { balance_building_not_forbidden = { TYPE = dock } }	# Balance mod: colony window build priorities
	audio_tier = 1
	is_foreign = no
	max_levels = 1
	pop_type = soldiers
	forbidden_for_estates = yes
	
	category = naval_category
	
	employment_size = dock_employment
	
	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	
	location_potential = {
		is_port = yes
	}
	
	build_time = medium_port_building_time

	
	unique_production_methods = {
		dock_maintenance = {
			tar = 0.2
			naval_supplies = 0.1
			tools = 0.2
			lumber = 0.2
			cloth = 0.1
			category = building_maintenance
		}

	}

	construction_demand = port_building_construction
	

	modifier = {
		max_ships_built_at_same_time = 1
		local_sailors = 0.016
		can_build_ships_in_this_location = yes
		harbor_suitability = 0.1
		local_repair_speed = 0.02

	}
	can_destroy = { balance_building_not_kept = yes  # Balance mod: colony window building lock
	}
}
